text:
Aditi Rao: Throwing a draft of an ops<->product handoff policy into the channel. Want feedback on launch gates and customer migration signals.
Ben Torres: thanks — quick read. high level: we need clear thresholds for when infra triggers tenant quarantine, and what product do before that.
Cara Nguyen: Agreed. Can we codify 3 tiers? 1) advisory, 2) throttling, 3) quarantine/evacuation. Simple numbers, not fuzzy.
Eli Park: +1. Proposal: advisory at 10% token-error increase over baseline for 1hr, throttling at 25% for 15m, quarantine if >40% or sustained 4h burn. Open to tuning.
Frida Morales: Those feel reasonable. Add a separate path for latency SLOs (p95 > 600ms). Different action: scale/reroute before quarantine.
Aditi Rao: Good call. Draft matrix in the doc:
- Error spike: advisory (10% x1h) -> prod to validate prompts -> throttling (25% x15m) -> infra to limit burst -> quarantine (40% x4h) -> migration.
- Latency breach: p95 600ms advisory -> p95 1s throttle -> sustained 90s fallback/quarantine.
Ben Torres: Can we include customer-facing steps? e.g., product to send notification to affected customers and open a migration opt-in flow.
Cara Nguyen: Yes. Also require a minimal rollback plan for model/quant changes: last-known-good pinned and instant fallback route.
Eli Park: Operational checklist item: create a temporary route with lower-cost model variant and KV-prefix caching enabled before doing tenant evacuation.
Frida Morales: For multi-region: prefer local region failover then inter-region; evacuation should be last resort and gated by compliance review for private deployments.
Aditi Rao: Launcher criteria we want signed off on:
1) Automated health rules implemented in infra (metrics + alarms)
2) Product-runbook for customer comms + migration UI
3) SRE-runbook for routing, scale, and rollback
4) Test run with one sandbox tenant
Ben Torres: I'd add a performance regression test (synthetic load matching 95th percentile) and a cost impact estimate for each action.
Cara Nguyen: How about migration velocity caps? We should limit concurrent tenant evac to avoid waterfall. Suggest cap = 5% of concurrent migrating traffic or 50 tenants, whichever smaller.
Eli Park: +1 to caps. Also add a cooldown of 1h between migration waves.
deploy-bot: Reminder: Q3 roadmap doc updated with these items under "handoff-policy-draft". PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/policies/hand-off
Frida Morales: One more ask — product needs a simple dashboard tile showing active advisory/throttle/quarantine counts by region and tenant tier.
Aditi Rao: I'll update the draft with the matrix, migration caps, and the dashboard ask. Can folks review by EOD Friday? We want this in the planning deck for next week.
Ben Torres: Reviewing now, will leave comments in the doc.
Cara Nguyen: I'll run the synthetic perf test draft and share numbers by Thursday.
Eli Park: I'll sketch the infra alarms and a sample alerting policy.
Frida Morales: Adding a checklist for compliance review for private deploys — will ping legal.
Aditi Rao: Thanks team. After signoff we map to rollout milestones: pilot (sandbox tenant) -> limited customers (30 days) -> cohort expansion -> GA. Document will include rollback SLAs and ownership matrix.
Ben Torres: Sounds good. small nit: call the quarantine step "tenant isolation" in the doc to avoid scary wording for sales.
Aditi Rao: noted. I'll change language and re-upload.
Cara Nguyen: tiny formatting suggestion: make the matrix a table with thresholds, actions, and owner columns.
Aditi Rao: done. Link to updated draft: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/policies/hand-off/1731234567
Eli Park: LGTM. If no objections, we lock for product backlog grooming next sprint.
Frida Morales: No objections from compliance side pending legal check.
Ben Torres: +1 from product.
